summary.name: AIVA
summary.one_liner: AIVA is an AI music generation assistant that creates new songs in more than 250 styles within seconds.
use_cases: create background music for content creators
produce tracks with custom style models
build music from uploaded MIDI or audio influences
monetize music on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok or Instagram
summary.what_it_does: AIVA generates new songs in over 250 musical styles in seconds, aimed at both beginners and experienced musicians. Users can create their own style models, upload an audio or MIDI file as an influence, and edit generated tracks. Tracks can be downloaded in multiple file formats. A Pro plan is offered for owning full copyright over compositions and monetizing them without restrictions. The page also showcases over 150 tracks generated by AIVA and arranged by humans.
notable: Generates songs in more than 250 styles
Upload audio or MIDI influences and create custom style models
Pro plan grants full copyright ownership of compositions
Student and school discounts available on request
caveats: Free tier is for non-commercial use only and requires credit to AIVA
Standard plan monetization is limited to YouTube, Twitch, TikTok and Instagram
Paid plans listed at €11/month (Standard) and €33/month (Pro) billed annually, plus VAT
